page.overview:
Who is Koji Hirose?

Koji Hirose (広瀬 康司 Hirose Kōji) is a major ally featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. Koji Hirose is one of the characters that Joji meets in the 37th universe and later helps him find Yoshikage Kira. Koji is also the user of the Stand, Blue Thunder.

Koji Hirose appears similarly to Koichi Hirose from Diamond is Unbreakable, but slightly taller and wears a white buttoned up T-shirt in his initial appearance. When using his Stand, Koji has a propeller on his head.

Koji is the user of the Stand, Blue Thunder. It is simply just a propeller on his head which allows him to fly.
